name: Thoroughbred Elf
desc: During your Main Phase: You can send 1 Equip Spell from your Deck to the GY, then this card gains 500 ATK until the end of your opponent's turn. You can only use this effect of "Thoroughbred Elf" once per turn. When this card destroys an opponent's monster by battle: You can add to your hand, or Special Summon, 1 Level 4 or lower LIGHT Spellcaster monster from your Deck, except "Thoroughbred Elf".

name: Assault Lion
desc: You can Tribute Summon this card face-up by Tributing 1 Beast-Warrior monster. If this card battles a monster, any battle damage it inflicts to your opponent is doubled. If a Beast-Warrior monster(s) is Normal or Special Summoned to your field while this card is in your GY: You can add this card to your hand, then immediately after this effect resolves, you can Tribute Summon this card face-up, and if you do, it gains 500 ATK, also banish it when it leaves the field. You can only use this effect of "Assault Lion" once per turn.

name: Power Connection
desc: Target any number of face-up monsters you control (if you target 2 or more monsters, they must have the same Type); they gain 500 ATK for each monster targeted, until the end of this turn. If you activated "Armament Reincarnation" this turn: You can add this card from your GY to your hand. You can only use each effect of "Power Connection" once per turn.

name: Ancient Secrets
desc:
Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your hand, Deck, or GY in Defense Position (if you Special Summon from the Deck, it must be Level 4 or lower), or if you control a Normal Monster Card, you can apply 1 of these effects instead.
● Destroy all monsters your opponent controls.
● Destroy all Spells/Traps your opponent controls.
● Draw 2 cards.
● Special Summon 1 monster from either GY to your field.
You can only activate 1 "Ancient Secrets" per turn.

name: Mind Mirror Force
desc:
If your opponent controls 5 or more face-up cards, this card's activation and effect cannot be negated, also you can activate this card the turn it was Set. At any of the following timings: Negate the effects of as many face-up cards your opponent controls as possible, and if you do, destroy them, also your monsters cannot attack directly until the end of the next turn after this card resolves.
● When the monster your opponent controls with the highest ATK (even if tied) declares an attack.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect that would destroy a card(s) on the field.
● When your opponent activates a monster effect in the hand or field during your turn.
str2: Activate by applying the effect of "Mind Mirror Force".

name: Emissaries from Darkness
desc:
If you take battle or effect damage: You can Special Summon this card from your hand, and if you do, gain 2000 LP, then you can apply 1 of these effects.
● Special Summon 1 "Emissaries from Darkness" from your hand, Deck, or GY.
● Destroy up to 2 Attack Position monsters your opponent controls.
During the End Phase, if this card was Special Summoned this turn: You can target 1 Trap in your GY; Set it. You can only use each effect of "Emissaries from Darkness" once per turn.

name: Dark Armed Dragon Punisher
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by having exactly 3 DARK monsters in your GY. You can reveal this card in your hand; Special Summon 1 Level 6 or lower DARK monster from your hand, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except DARK monsters. During the Main Phase (Quick Effect): You can banish up to 3 DARK monsters from your GY, then target that many cards on the field; destroy them. You can only use each effect of "Dark Armed Dragon Punisher" once per turn.

name: Ekhajar, Descendant Dragon of the Ice Barrier
desc:
1 Tuner + 1+ non-Tuners
If this card is Synchro Summoned: You can discard 1 card; banish 2 cards from your opponent's field and/or GY. If your opponent Special Summons a monster(s): You can banish 1 card from your hand; return 1 card in either field or GY to the hand. If this Synchro Summoned card is sent to the GY during your opponent's turn: You can banish 1 card from your opponent's hand (at random), field, or GY. You can only use each effect of "Ekhajar, Descendant Dragon of the Ice Barrier" once per turn.

name: Number 101: Silent Honor ARK - Soul Asylum
desc:
2 Level 4 monsters
You can detach 1 material from this card, then activate 1 of these effects;
● Choose 1 Level 4 monster in your GY, except the detached material, and add 1 Level 4 monster with the same Type and Attribute, but a different name, from your Deck to your hand.
● Target 1 monster your opponent controls; attach it to this card.
You can only use this effect of "Number 101: Silent Honor ARK - Soul Asylum" once per turn. If this card would be destroyed, you can detach 1 material from this card instead.

If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can Set 1 "Dominators" or "Dominus Purge" Trap from your Deck or GY. It can be activated this turn.

name: Sennet Prophet - Nefertari
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send it to the GY; show up to 2 Normal Monster Cards from your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then Set that many "Sennet" Spells from your Deck. During your opponent's turn (Quick Effect): You can banish this card from your GY; equip 1 Normal Monster from your GY to 1 Ritual Monster you control as an Equip Spell. You can only use each effect of "Sennet Prophet - Nefertari" once per turn.

name: Sennet Prophet - Amenhotep
desc: If this card is Normal or Special Summoned: You can send it to the GY; show up to 2 Normal Monster Cards from your hand, Deck, face-up field, and/or GY, then Set that many "Sennet" Traps from your Deck. You can banish this card from your GY, then target up to 3 Normal Monsters in your GY; shuffle them into the Deck. You can only use each effect of "Sennet Prophet - Amenhotep" once per turn.

name: Sennetnakht Sphinx
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Sennet" card. This card equipped with an Equip Card is unaffected by your opponent's activated effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Sennetnakht Sphinx" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 "Sennet" card from your Deck to your hand, except "Sennetnakht Sphinx". (Quick Effect): You can send 1 face-up Normal Monster Card you control to the GY; change as many monsters your opponent controls as possible to face-down Defense Position, then you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY.

name: Tausennet Wadjet
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Sennet" card. This card equipped with an Equip Card cannot be destroyed by card effects. You can only use each of the following effects of "Tausennet Wadjet" once per turn. You can discard this card; send 1 "Sennet" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Tausennet Wadjet". (Quick Effect): You can send up to 3 face-up Normal Monster Cards you control to the GY, then target that many cards your opponent controls; return them to the hand, then you can Special Summon 1 Normal Monster from your GY.

name: Sennetmes Nekhbet
desc: You can Ritual Summon this card with any "Sennet" card. This card equipped with an Equip Card cannot be destroyed by battle. You can only use each of the following effects of "Sennetmes Nekhbet" once per turn. You can discard this card; add 1 "Sennet" card from your GY to your hand, except "Sennetmes Nekhbet". (Quick Effect): You can Special Summon 1 face-up Normal Monster Card from your Spell & Trap Zone, and if you do, equip this card you control to it as an Equip Spell that gives it 2500 ATK.

name: Beresennet Em Heru
desc: Once per turn: You can Ritual Summon 1 "Sennet" Ritual Monster from your hand or GY, by sending Normal Monster Cards with different names from each other from your hand, Deck, and/or face-up field to the GY whose total Levels equal or exceed its Level, then you can equip 1 Normal Monster from your GY to it as an Equip Spell. If you Special Summon a non-Token Normal Monster(s): You can draw 1 card. You can only use this effect of "Beresennet Em Heru" once per turn.

name: Sennet Per Akh
desc: Add 1 "Sennet" monster from your Deck to your hand. If you discard a "Sennet" Ritual Monster(s) while this card is in your GY: You can banish this card; Special Summon 1 non-Effect Fusion Monster from your Extra Deck with ATK less than or equal to any of the discarded monsters' as a Normal Monster Card, but for the rest of this turn, it cannot attack directly, also you cannot activate non-Zombie monster effects. You can only use each effect of "Sennet Per Akh" once per turn.

desc: Choose opponent's Main Monster Zones equal to the number of Normal Monsters and "Sennet" Ritual Monsters you control; negate the first monster effect activated in each of those zones that resolves this turn. If the total ATK of all Normal Monster Cards you control is more than 3000: You can banish this card from your GY, then target 1 monster your opponent controls; send it to the GY. You can only use each effect of "Sennet Cataract" once per turn.

name: Sennet Thunderfall
desc: When your opponent activates a Spell/Trap Card while you control a Normal Monster or "Sennet" Ritual Monster: Negate the activation, and if you do, destroy that card. If the total ATK of all Normal Monster Cards you control is more than 3000: You can banish this card from your GY; Set 1 "Sennet" Spell/Trap from your Deck or GY, except "Sennet Thunderfall". You can only use each effect of "Sennet Thunderfall" once per turn.

name: Dark Paladin - Wave-Motion
desc:
"Dark Magician" + 1 Level 7 or higher monster
Must be Fusion Summoned. Gains 500 ATK for every other monster on the field. Can attack all your opponent's monsters, once each. Once per turn, when your opponent activates a Spell Card or effect (Quick Effect): You can negate that effect, then you can destroy 1 card on the field. After this card destroys a card by battle or card effect and sends it to the GY, neither player can activate its effects while it is in the GY.

desc:
2+ monsters, including a Pendulum Monster
You can target 1 other card you control; destroy it, and if you do, draw 1 card. During your turn, when your opponent activates a card or effect (Quick Effect): You can discard 1 card; negate that effect. You can only use each of the preceding effects of "Odd-Eyes Override Dragon" once per turn. If you destroyed a Pendulum Monster Card by this card's first effect, during your Main Phase this turn, you can conduct 1 Pendulum Summon of a "Performapal" monster(s), "Magician" Pendulum Monster(s), and/or "Odd-Eyes" monster(s), in addition to your Pendulum Summon (you can only gain this effect once per turn).

name: Lunalight Scarlet Tiger

If this card is sent to the GY by card effect: You can Special Summon 1 "Lunalight" monster from your face-up Extra Deck or GY, except a Level 5 monster, but it cannot activate its effects. You can only use each effect of "Lunalight Scarlet Tiger" once per turn.

name: Speedroid Darumaknocker
desc: If this card is in your hand: You can send 1 "Speedroid" card from your Deck to the GY, except "Speedroid Darumaknocker"; Special Summon this card, also you cannot Special Summon for the rest of this turn, except WIND monsters. If this card is sent from the field to the GY: You can add 1 "Speedroid" Spell/Trap from your Deck to your hand, then if you control a "Clear Wing" monster, you can destroy 1 monster on the field. You can only use each effect of "Speedroid Darumaknocker" once per turn.
